name: Kushinada Toa
source:
"Cats are the only one who willingly come to me after all."

A nerdy young man who has a deep love of movies, comics, and cats. He has difficulty interacting with people, so he tends to speak politely and avoid making eye contact.

As the poster child of the unathletic, he often trips over thin air, scattering whatever items happen to be in his bulging pockets.

He’s extremely nearsighted, so he has thick glasses, and he insists on wearing his favorite padded dotera kimono, even in the summer.
